newsitem.title: USA: CBOT SOYBEANS AND CORN FALL FURTHER ON FORECASTS.
newsitem.headline: CBOT SOYBEANS AND CORN FALL FURTHER ON FORECASTS.

text.p: CBOT corn and soybean futures fell further in fast dealings on Thursday amid forecasts for rain this weekend in the U.S. Midwest, traders said.
Pit sources said Tom Skilling, a closely-watched television meteorologist, said in his midday update that rains would reach the U.S. Midwest this weekend.
"Skilling has more rain in the forecast," a trader said.

Trade in corn and soybeans has been volatile this week with moves tied largely to weather forecasts. Another weekend of dry weather could damage developing crops but timely rains could improve conditions, traders said.
At 1253 CDT, soybeans were down 24-1/2 to 15-1/2 cents per bushel with November down 23-1/2 at $6.26-1/2. Corn was down eight to 4-1/2 cents per bushel with December down eight at $2.53-1/2.
